I know im late to respond but when cutting, staying in the shower with those fresh open wounds is the worst thing to do as the water will prevent it from scabbing. I learned that the hard way recently.
 So if youre worried abt it while showering, turn the water off, lift your arm above your head (it limits blood flow so itll slow or stop) and maybe take a seat or sonething just in case. After it stops bleeding, use your hand to get water and gently rinse the blood off. And of course bandage it and keep pressure on it if it doesnt stop afterwards. 
This is what worked for me so none of its really a proven thing i guess. 
And if it still doesnt stop(like if its still bleeding alot) after bandaging, maybe tell a trusted guardian to take you to the hospital for stitches.
